This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] that was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. He assisted [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Gira]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] group of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] in escaping the forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. When the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] under him [[Battle aboard an unidentified ship|attacked]] the commander's ship, the commander betrayed Gira by surrendering to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. Vader ordered him to place explosives on the escape vessel that the Padawans fled in. After Vader convinced Gira to join him, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] betrayed Gira by ordering the commander to detonate the explosives, killing the Padawans.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The commander first appeared in the story "[[The Duty]]," which was featured in ''[[Star Wars Tales 12]]'' and written by [[Christian Read]]. The story was later compiled into a trade paperback version, ''[[Star Wars Tales Volume 3]]''. Plausible stories in ''[[Star Wars Tales 1]]''&ndash;''[[Star Wars Tales 20|20]]'' were initially viewed as [[Canon|S-canon]] until referenced in a non-''Tales'' source, at which point the subject matter was elevated to C-canon status.<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=752#14952461|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-06-04|time=3:05 AM}}</ref> The commander was later mentioned in Gira's entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', treating the commander as a unique character and raising his existence in ''The Duty'' to C-canon.
